$comment: Machine-readable summary of Signet governance + receipt checks. Source of truth is src/validator.ts, src/governance.ts, src/verify.ts via the CLI.

governance_checks.rule: A lock enforced_by agent_receipt is attestation, not runtime enforcement
type=behavioral lock must have paired_with referencing a GATE or AT
GATE with evaluator=human must carry approval_id; unsatisfied at run time => gate FAILS
output_contract.forbidden_outputs and scope.excluded checked against declared actions
agent_assertion cannot satisfy a gate or acceptance test
VERIFICATION_LEDGER counts must equal actual block counts

verdicts.PASS_WITH_LIMITS: valid but some checks UNEVALUATED in simulation or rely on warning-level evidence

receipt_verification.sha256: byte integrity of the whole receipt
receipt_verification.signature: UNSIGNED unless a Signet Authority signed it

simulation_note: Simulation evaluates declared actions, not live agent behavior.
